title: Reuse Terminology For CAD
description: Extend the terminology mechanism (already shipped for puzzle 3d) to the CAD app: add a "reuse"/"Wiederverwendung" terminology that remaps CAD's primary entity noun "Object"/"Objects" to "Building component"/"Building components" (en) and "Baukomponente"/"Baukomponenten" (de), consistent with puzzle 3d's wording. Also investigate a user report that the puzzle 3d terminology dropdown wasn't visible (root-caused to a transient WASM-boot timeout under heavy concurrent build load on the machine, not a code defect).
summary:
Extended CadLabels from a single "Object"/"Objects" pair to full coverage of CAD's structural/navigational vocabulary: model-definition pane names (Shape/Building/Energy/Structure Classic), typology catalog entries (Box/Slab/Column/Beam/Wall/External Wall, resolved via a new typology_label(typology_id, labels) function keyed on the stable typology id rather than the duplicated-text native label), inspector group titles (Primitive/Reference/Node), toolbar group names (View/Save/Transfer/Construct), tree section names (References/Nodes/Typologies), and tree item action verbs (Hide/Show/Lock/Unlock/Duplicate/Delete). All of these now get full native German translation. Additionally extended the "reuse" terminology remap to the Primitive/"Component part"/"Bauteil" pair (CAD's sub-entity, directly analogous to puzzle 3d's Vortex→Connection point) — reuse remapping stays scoped to genuine entity/sub-entity nouns (Object+Primitive), not generic UI verbs or catalog instance names, matching puzzle 3d's own precedent of leaving generic actions untouched.

Added 3 new tests (document tree pane names in German, catalogue typology names in German, primitive reuse terminology in German) alongside the 4 from the prior pass — 55/55 cad-plugin tests pass, cargo check clean. Fixed one compile error along the way: typology_label's fallback path tried to return a non-'static &str while promising &'static str; narrowed the parameter to &'static str since both call sites already pass typology ids from the 'static TYPOLOGY_CATALOG.

Verified live in the CAD playground (port 6020, wasm rebuilt) after switching Language to Deutsch: Document tree reads FORM/GEBÄUDE/ENERGIE/STRUKTUR KLASSISCH/REFERENZEN/KNOTEN, Catalogue tree reads TYPOLOGIEN with Box/Platte/Stütze/Balken/Wand/Außenwand — all confirmed via screenshots. Settings restored to English/Native before leaving the shared dev session.

Scope note (documented for the user, not implemented here): the same *Labels-struct-plus-ViewState-resolver pattern now needs to be applied to the other ~25 plugin apps in the repo (puzzle 2d/5d, forms, draw, flow, gis, layout, lowpoly, note, raster, shooting, trinity ×2, writer, vcs, etc.), which collectively have roughly 400+ hardcoded English UI label strings and currently zero locale/terminology support. That is a separate, much larger effort tracked outside this ticket.
